name: Mpox
summary: Clade I mpox cases spread across US states; local spread in Europe; no PHEIC
state: The US has confirmed 23 clade I mpox cases this year and the CDC expects more (Medical Daily); Connecticut confirmed its first clade I case. Russia has reported a third clade I case in Moscow (Tech Times, 1 Nov). Europe has reported local transmission. No PHEIC is in force as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Follow CDC, UKHSA or local health advice on symptoms and vaccination if at higher risk.
